import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
customer_demands = [r for r in LEGACY_RECORDS if r['source'].endswith('customer_demand.csv')]
customers = [r['values']['customer'] for r in customer_demands]
demand = {r['values']['customer']: float(r['values']['demand']) for r in customer_demands}
supply_caps = [r for r in LEGACY_RECORDS if r['source'].endswith('supply_capacity.csv')]
supply_centers = [r['values']['Unnamed: 0'] for r in supply_caps]
capacity = {r['values']['Unnamed: 0']: float(r['values']['supply_capacity']) for r in supply_caps}
cost_rows = [r for r in LEGACY_RECORDS if r['source'].endswith('transportation_costs.csv')]
transport_cost = {}
for row in cost_rows:
    s = row['values']['Unnamed: 0']
    for c in customers:
        if (s, c) in transport_cost:
            raise ValueError(f'Duplicate cost entry for ({s},{c})')
        if c not in row['values']:
            raise ValueError(f'Missing cost for ({s},{c})')
        transport_cost[s, c] = float(row['values'][c])
if set(customers) != set([f'C{i}' for i in range(1, 13)]):
    raise ValueError('Customer set mismatch')
if set(supply_centers) != set([f'S{i}' for i in range(1, 13)]):
    raise ValueError('Supply center set mismatch')
for s in supply_centers:
    for c in customers:
        if (s, c) not in transport_cost:
            raise ValueError(f'Missing transportation cost for ({s},{c})')
m = gp.Model('OptimalFulfillmentPolicy')
x_vars = m.addVars(supply_centers, customers, lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='')
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((transport_cost[s, c] * x_vars[s, c] for s in supply_centers for c in customers)), GRB.MINIMIZE)
m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum((x_vars[s, c] for s in supply_centers)) == demand[c] for c in customers), name='')
m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum((x_vars[s, c] for c in customers)) <= capacity[s] for s in supply_centers), name='')
m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
m.optimize()
if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
    for var in m.getVars():
        print(f'{var.VarName}: {var.X}')
else:
    print(f'Solver status: {m.Status}')
